reviews.comment: She should have higher ratings. Literally everything is informative, straight forward and easy. I have over a 100% in the class. So much extra credit.

I wish I cared about literally anything as much as Dr. Shepherd cares about bees. For a 300 class it was really easy. I don't know why other people were stressing about the youtube project. I did it day-of and got a 95. The class goes really in depth about bees, and while I have no interest in bees, some of it was understandable and interesting lol

The class wasn't very difficult and there weren't too many assignments but her feedback on assignments felt pretty belittling honestly, especially since it would often be audio feedback and her tone of voice was very dismissive. Other than that, the class is fine. I wish she didn't change the final project from group to individual.

If your not interested, or don't know anything about honey bees don't take this class. She expects you to be an expert/scientist and know a lot for the final project. This class shouldn't be as hard as she is making it. Test are long, and you don't know what to study. Never gave clear feedback, and honestly made me feel like I couldn't do it right.

Her online lectures are great- short and to the point. She gives very detailed feedback on the rough draft of the project due at the end of the semester. Her exams are not too hard either. The only thing that I did not really like is there is a PackBack due every single week.

Dr. Shepard is just a difficult person. I took the class online, so my interactions with her were limited, but I could tell that she and I would not get along. Her emails and instructions are written in a grating, self-important way that feels almost insufferable. The class is way too difficult for what it is, and she only makes it more difficult.

People who are saying this isn't an easy A haven't heard of socratic or quizlet. It was extremely easy, I did not actually watch or read a single lecture and ended with a 98. I started the project the day it was due and got an 85, it's not that hard. The extra credit at the end helped a lot too and boosted my letter grade by 5.

I took this thinking it would be a blow off class and it was not. Super kind professor but that final project and those end-of-semester mental-health issues are an awful combo... If you communicate with her, even if it's 2 days before the project is due she will be understanding. Take the class 100% but don't expect it to be as easy as you may want

The assignments are not bad at all. Many people complain about the YouTube project, but it isn't that terrible. It is time-consuming; get an early start, and you will do great. She is strict but very communicative and caring. It is a very interesting course! She is strict but caring, ask for help, and she will help you.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dont wait on the Youtube project. Follow the rubric. I had so much anxiety over this project but in the end it worked out well. She is great with communication. Read the information thats given everything is there 100%.  Packbacks save your grade. I made 70's on the exams and got an A in the class. Totally doable.

I took this course as an elective, there are weekly packback assignments, the exams are 65 questions, and the youtube project was pretty extensive. Have to work to get the A, should be interested in bees to get a lot out of the course

I took Dr. Shepherd's online course, and it was great! She provided lectures for us and all the assignments were on packback so we were still able to interact with classmates. The information is so interesting and I definitely recommend this class to anyone who wants to learn more about honey bees!! Take this class and prof :)
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Shepherd is brilliant, although seemingly aloof to the fact that this was a non-majors course. Im not a scientist. I was interested in learning about bees. She treated us like scientists and expected us t contribute content weekly. It was exhausting as a last semester senior taking 18hrs, a capstone, and working. No easy A, you have to hustle here.

Class wasn't difficult but the YouTube project was a lot. Follow the rubric and the given comments on your draft and you should be fine. It wasn't pleasant at all, but I got through it with a B for the project. The project was very stressful but the only bad thing I felt in the class. No reviews, just notes and watch the short vids, easy to study.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Shepherd was very nice and does care about her students. My main complaints are that there was so much content and no guide for what would be on exams. So it was very hard to study. The tests were very difficult. The YouTube project is hard, but if you follow the rubric you will be fine.
The class wasn't bad but the final project was very difficult and she graded it very harshly. It actually tanked my grade.

Idk why everyone is saying Shepherd grades hard. The bulk of your grade is discussion posts (which were never hard) and exams. The exams were never tricky but they were def long and required studying. The final research project was tedious but it was not too bad. Put in effort and you will get an A.

Do not take her. She makes this class so difficult for no reason. Her tests have so many questions it is hard to even know what you will be tested over. There are so many assignments and she grades super harsh. It makes the class unenjoyable and definitely not a fun, interesting elective

Shepherd is so rude. Her class is fairly easy if you choose to put the effort in. Make sure you read all the directions before submission because she is ruthless with ANY mistakes made. Don't take this course for an easy A or for fun because she makes sure that it won't be fun or easy.

*5 week Summer Course* Was very organised & fairly easy. Very fast pace, 5 lectures, 2 optional quizzes and 2-3 discussions, and an exam EVERY week. Final is cumulative, there is a project. Kinda difficult, but once you know what you are doing will take about a day or two. Gives extra credit which is helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Took fall20. This class wasn't bad overall, taking as an EE major. It was fairly easy until the last exam and the final project. Those two things were tougher than expected but extra credit helped me out. This class is a slight notch up from an easy A because of that final project. Otherwise, everything else is very simple. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was an easy A for me. The project was a little tough at first but I was able to do it in about a day or two. The exams were fairly easy. None of them were curveballs which and I am thankful that Dr. Shepherd went easy on us. The information was fairly interesting. This is coming from an engineer. Would definitely recommend this class
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I struggled in this class more than any other class I've taken at A&M. This is coming from an engineering major. I wish I didn't take this class. If you are an engineering major, expect to put more work in here than your other classes because of that crazy individual youtube project. Y'all have been warned! Even CSCE 121 is easier than this!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Overall, it's not a terrible classs. However, the individual project sucks. I hope I can do well on it so I can make an A in here but it is highly unlikely. I would suggest y'all take another class such as ATMO201 or some other easy elective. The project is really making me regret taking this class because I will probably end up with a B. GL!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I thought it was going to be an easy A, but it was actually pretty tough. Exams and quizzes were doable, but the youtube video research project final project was very stressful for my first ENTO class as a non-ENTO major.

I took this class to satisfy an upper-level (300/400) elective. It was really interesting but a LOT more work than I expected, and a lot harder than I expected. There is a video research project at the end of the semester that she grades quite hard. Interesting class but definitely wouldn't recommend if you arent an ENTO or BIOL major or

Lots of online quizzes, not very difficult but she asks questions over material that she did not go over. There is one ridiculously large group project that is just a nuisance and doesn't teach you anything. All in all a pretty boring class taught by a mediocre prof.

Professor Shepherd is a really great and organized professor. There are a lot of assignments in this online course, but it's very doable. The group project was probably the most amount of work. Just be on top of your assignments and DO NOT procrastinate or you'll be stressed. She also gives great feedback, and is very passionate about the subject.

Dr. Shepherd really loves bees and loves teaching about them! I just finished this class online for the summer semester and it was the easiest biology class I've ever taken. There is one group project, but it is not hard at all. She gives extra credit through the semester and the quizzes and tests are straight from the lecture material.

Dr. Shepherd was a really great prof! She was easy to get in contact with and clearly wanted her students to do well. She gave tons on extra credit and really good constructive criticism. The tests were very easy and you can find most of the answers in your notes and online. The only downside to this class was the group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Literally the easiest class I have ever taken. You can find all answer online for the most part, and she gives a good amount of extra credit. You do have to work a little on the discussion posts, as they're about things you don't cover in lecture, so you have to do some research. She's kind of nitpicky grading assignments/discussions, but not bad
